    "37dd986a: ;\n .;DGJXE17 is the input transform for field .11 (STATUS) of the PROSTHETIC\n .;SITE PARAMETER file (#393). This determines if the device is\n .;'recommended' or 'stock' at this station.\n .; ",

    "9aac5ad7: ;Branch to data sub-node",

    "fe9083a7: ;If X is '@', call D and go to Z^DIE2.",
    "3ecf965c: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV does not contain 'P', and a default value exists for the current user and label, set X to that default value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the value of X.",
    "cd165416: ;If DV is not null, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If a computed expression exists for the current field, execute it. If DIC('S') exists, execute it. If DB(DQ) is undefined, write the computed expression. If a match is found, go to V.",
    "ddfdd786: ;For each semicolon piece of DU, check if it matches X. If DIC('S') exists, execute it. If a match is found, quit the loop.",
    "a2de612a: ;If DB(DQ) is undefined, write the remaining piece of the matched entry in DU. Set X to the piece before the colon.",
    "78004b83: ;If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the appropriate value and call ^DIC. If successful, set X to the returned value and DIC to DIE. If X is less than 0, go to X.",
    "1f9f95f3: ;If DV does not contain 'N' and the length of the decimal portion of X exceeds 24, kill X and go to Z.",
    "5a460c5e: ;If the second piece of DV is numeric and X contains a decimal point, remove any leading or trailing zeros from the decimal portion of X. If the decimal portion is null and X contains a decimal point, convert X to numeric.",
    "f2a8785e: ;Execute the 'X' label for the current value of DQ, then kill YS.",
    "f877bd34: ;Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not equal to the up-arrow, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set the default value for the current user and label to X, then go to A.",
    "44ca0f47: ;Write a beep and '??'. If DB(DQ) is defined, go to Z^DIE17.",
    "376295e2: ;Set X to '?BAD'.",
    "05dcbf67: ;Set DZ to X, call D, call QQ^DIEQ, and go to B.",
    "a6f3c94c: ;Set up the loop variables and Q string",
    "b3a45790: ;If DE(DQ) is undefined, overwrite X with user input. Goto A if input is not required, goto N if input is not @.",
    "1ffc65d6: ;If DE(DQ) is defined, get the previous value of a multiple from DQ(DQ,2)",
    "f4e79e0a: ;If DV is pointing to a new-style x-ref, get x-ref value in X and go to RP",
    "ef90097f: ;If DV is 'V', get the x-ref value from @(u_$p(...)) and go to R",
    "880bde01: ;If DV is 'S', set Y to the external x-ref value",
    "43a1d0be: ;If X is null, revert to the old X value, then goto A if no editing or N^DIE17 if required",
    "39a1b344: ;If DV doesn't require an ask, goto RD",
    "c6522356: ;Otherwise call E^DIE0 to validate input and either RD or PR",
    "cfd4259b: ;Exit point for unexpected input during validation",
    "43d3278b: ;Entry point, set MUMPS variables DNM and DQ",
    "ca9d87bb: ;Field .11 attributes for 'STATUS' of file 393",
    "700569ff: ;DU string for retrieving records from 393.2 global",
    "0a091662: ;Initialize X to the value of DGJTST for the STATUS field",
    "96c9b541: ;Initialize Y to the value of X before editing",
    "7c4aab98: If the internal value of the current entry is defined and the DATA TYPE has the 'I' (Inquire) or '#' (Multiple) specifiers, execute the code in the INPUT TRANSFORM of the .01 field.",
    "02f2d79c: If the internal value is truth-y, jump to the HELP MESSAGE logic. Otherwise, execute READ logic.",
    "a6249841: This label does nothing and can be removed.",
    "36dd9e44: Jump to the EXIT CODE of the INIT node."
  ]
